text:
maria: AM check — sprint lift / gate check for the next cadence. Quick status:
- Yesterday: finished spec draft for routing fallbacks and traffic-splitting matrix. PR is up (https://git.company/r/redwood/specs/-/merge_requests/412).
- Blocker: Observability dashboard missing the ‘prefix-cache hit rate’ metric; can't validate perf improvements for batching. Need someone from infra to add it to the trace agent.
- Today: polish spec based on @sanjay notes, merge, and tag for eng review. Also want to confirm canary window (2h) and rollback criteria.

sanjay: Thanks — looks solid. I'll pick up the PR review after standup. For the dashboard, infra needs the span name we emit. Can you paste the telemetry key here?

maria: telemetry key is `inference.prefix_cache.hit_rate_v1` — added to the spec under observability.

ben: noted. I'll add the metric to the trace agent this morning. ETA ~ 90m. Once it's in, we can hook it into the console dashboard.

lisa: I can run the perf checks once the metric is available. If @maria merges by noon I can do a quick sweep and report regressions. Also available to own manual QA for the canary if we need it.

maria: awesome, thanks @lisa. Canary plan I'm proposing: 2h window, 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% if stable. Rollback if average tail-latency increases > 30ms or prefix-cache hit drops > 10%. Any objections?

sanjay: no objections but want to add a quality gate: check generation divergence on the eval set (10 prompts) — if more than 4/10 fail semantic parity, stop rollout. I can wire the eval harness to run automatically at each step.

maria: great, add that to the rollout policy. Could you paste the tiny snippet for the automation hook?

sanjay: ```yaml
rollout_steps:
  - pct: 5
    checks:
      - metric: inference.tail_latency.p99
        op: lt
        threshold_ms: 200
      - metric: inference.prefix_cache.hit_rate_v1
        op: gt
        threshold_pct: 65
      - hook: eval-harness/quick-semantic-check
        max_fails: 4
```

maria: perfect. I'll add that to the spec and the MR description.

ben: deploy-bot scheduled a maintenance window for the infra agent at 11:30 — FYI this might briefly affect metric ingestion. Deploy-bot: maintenance_id=mnt-2026-03-17-1130 :warning:

deploy-bot: maintenance scheduled for mnt-2026-03-17-1130, window 30m. Alerts will be suppressed for agent restarts.

lisa: heads up — if maintenance aligns with our first canary step we should shift the canary +30m. I don't want missing metrics during the 5% check.

maria: good catch. Let's aim to start canary at 12:15 instead of 11:45. Ben, can the trace agent change be applied before 12?

ben: yes, will prioritize. If anything slips I'll post an update in this thread.

sanjay: PR reviewers — ping me here when you're done. I want to pair on the A/B traffic routing config for the fallback path. Small reminder: update the model-version map in `deploy/configs/models.yaml` with the compatibility flags.

maria: noted. final checklist before merging:
- [ ] add telemetry key to trace agent (ben)
- [ ] run quick perf sweep (lisa)
- [ ] finalize PR comments + tagging (sanjay + maria)
- [ ] confirm canary start time (everyone)

Any other blockers? :eyes:

lisa: none from QA. I'll report back with results in this thread. :thumbsup:

ben: starting agent change now. Will update with timestamp when pushed.

maria: thanks all — I'll update MR and set canary to 12:15 if we get green on the metric. If anything urgent ping me directly.

sanjay: one tiny nit — in the spec, under "fallbacks" we should call out deterministic logging for regen attempts. I'll drop a comment.

maria: please do. small changes welcome.

lisa: perf sweep complete — no regressions on the 12 test prompts; prefix-cache hit went from 52% -> 71% in local canary run. Posting logs in thread in a sec.

ben: trace agent pushed at 11:40, metric is live.

maria: beautiful. Moving forward with canary at 12:15. Will post rollout link once deployed. :rocket:
